description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Dataset', which represents a data collection for plotting in a charting library. It includes methods for managing data points, retrieving dataset statistics, and internal data handling, indicating it is a key part of a graph rendering utility.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset
classes.description: A class representing a data set used to model a collection of data points for chart plotting, supporting data addition and statistical analysis.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dataset for labeling purposes.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a data point with X, Y values and optional metadata, updating dataset bounds.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of data points in the dataset.

methods.name: minimumX
methods.description: Returns the minimum X value in the dataset.

methods.name: maximumX
methods.description: Returns the maximum X value in the dataset.

methods.name: minimumY
methods.description: Returns the minimum Y value in the dataset.

methods.name: maximumY
methods.description: Returns the maximum Y value in the dataset.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first point (minimum X and Y).

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last point (maximum X and Y).

methods.name: _getPointX
methods.description: Retrieves the X component from a data point.

methods.name: _getPointY
methods.description: Retrieves the Y component from a data point.

methods.name: _getPointID
methods.description: Retrieves the ID associated with a data point.

methods.name: _getPointData
methods.description: Retrieves auxiliary data associated with a data point.

methods.name: _stepX
methods.description: Returns the interval between adjacent X points.

methods.name: _stepY
methods.description: Returns the interval between adjacent Y points.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets internal pointer to start from minimum X.

methods.name: _nearby
methods.description: Returns a point near the internal pointer, with optional offset.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Advances internal pointer and returns the next data point.

methods.name: _averageY
methods.description: Calculates average Y value across dataset.

methods.name: _median
methods.description: Calculates median of a data array or specified quartile.

methods.name: _medianY
methods.description: Calculates median Y value across dataset.
